description:
Members. Who may read where in a workspace (0.83.0): each folder its owner shared for reading with some
    members only, with the members named. You see only the lists on folders you read yourself. A folder with a
    list is read by the owner, the members named, and any member named to write in it; to everyone else it is not
    there. Everywhere else every member reads, as before.
